key_highlights: ASX initially eyed gains but slid as oil near US$100 fueled RBA rate-hike bets; big four banks (CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC) fell
Iron ore in severe downturn – BHP, RIO, FMG under pressure; headline suggests BHP existential risk
Gold sector strong: Manhattan, Forrestania (2M oz), Kaiser, Larvotto all reporting positive discoveries
Property sector faces 'GFC moment' with home buyer sentiment collapsing; NZ house crash echoes
Santos (STO) in crisis as gas cartel dynamics break; Hormuz Strait escalation adds energy risk
Living standards under pressure: small business cost creep, mortgage-driven second jobs, public sector boom masking decline
Qantas (QAN) $35M redundancy payout signals ongoing airline sector stress

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural decline ('drowning'); BHP, RIO, FMG under severe pressure. Gold counter-cyclical strength with multiple ASX-listed discoveries (Manhattan, Forrestania, Kaiser, Larvotto).
sectors.implications: Rotate out of iron ore exposure; overweight gold miners and explorers. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Gold names (GOLD, MNG, KAL) offer relative strength.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fell as oil-driven inflation fears revived RBA rate-hike expectations. Property 'GFC moment' raises NPL concerns for mortgage books.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face dual pressure: rate volatility and property credit risk. Defensive yield plays but growth outlook impaired.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Hormuz Strait escalation. Santos (STO) in crisis as gas cartel dynamics break. El Nino adds supply risk.
sectors.implications: STO.AX high-risk; upstream oil (WDS, WES) benefit from oil spike but geopolitical risk is two-edged. LNG exporters face pricing volatility.

sectors.trend: Small businesses struggling with 'insidious cost creep'; 102-year-old mall retailer closing 25 stores; Qantas $35M payout; consumers working second jobs.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX (retail lending), and consumer discretionary names under pressure. Defensive staples preferred.

sectors.trend: Home buyer sentiment at multi-year low; property industry facing 'GFC moment'; NZ house crash provides cautionary parallel.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW, DGL, ICV) and property developers (MRG, WBC) face demand deterioration. Mortgage stress rising.

sectors.trend: Rural doctor drought persists; Tasmanian surgery wait targets 'lower the bar'; Brisbane ED attack highlights system strain.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, and private health (IAG, MCF) benefit from public system gaps. Structural tailwind for private healthcare.

key_themes: Iron ore structural decline vs gold counter-cyclical strength
Oil at US$100 and Hormuz Strait escalation driving inflation/rate-hike fears
Property market at inflection point – GFC parallels
Living standards collapse masked by public sector employment
Santos gas cartel breakdown reshaping energy landscape
El Nino adding agricultural and energy supply risk
Small business and consumer squeeze intensifying

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX exposure; rotate into gold and diversified miners
Hedge energy exposure; monitor WES.AX, WDS.AX; consider AUD/USD as oil-driven inflation hedges AUD
Underweight REITs and property developers; monitor bank NPL trajectories

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced rate hike on oil-driven inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour short-duration bonds; reduce rate-sensitive growth equities
Avoid STO.AX; monitor gas pricing impact on WES.AX and downstream consumers
Monitor agricultural and energy supply chains; WES.AX, BHP.AX (copper) weather exposure

opportunities.rationale: Multiple positive discoveries (Manhattan, Forrestania 2M oz, Kaiser, Larvotto); gold as safe-haven amid geopolitical and inflation risk
Public system strain (rural doctor drought, surgery waits) drives structural demand for private providers

opportunities.recommendation: Selective upstream oil exposure on Hormuz risk
opportunities.rationale: Oil near US$100; WES and WDS benefit from sustained premium pricing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore / diversified miner exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural decline; BHP existential risk flagged; margin compression likely
GFC-level sentiment collapse; rising NPL risk for banks; NZ crash as leading indicator

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Santos; reduce gas-dependent energy names
defensive_moves.rationale: Gas cartel breakdown creates pricing and governance uncertainty for STO

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate-hike risk with short-duration fixed income
defensive_moves.rationale: Oil-driven inflation may force RBA to pause easing or hike; banks already under pressure

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure. Oil near US$100 and Hormuz escalation keep rate-hike fears alive, weighing on banks and rate-sensitive sectors. Iron ore weakness drags materials. Gold and defensive healthcare provide relative outperformance. Expect volatility around RBA commentary.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift away from iron ore dependency toward gold, energy transition, and healthcare. Property correction may deepen over 6-12 months. Living standards pressure could force policy response. Gold and healthcare offer multi-year structural tailwinds.
